orientation.cusp_ion_current: positive out of the axial ion-current control volume
orientation.terminal_ion_current: signed; not replaced by an absolute value

geometry_requirements.cells: unique IDs with contiguous axial_order from zero
geometry_requirements.interior_cusps: one geometry-identified edge per adjacent cell pair
geometry_requirements.finite_boundary_nulls: classified and excluded, never inferred by a solver window
geometry_requirements.terminals: one cathode on the first cell and one anode on the last cell
geometry_requirements.uncertainty: interior and terminal loss probabilities plus optional mirror ratios carry standard uncertainty
geometry_requirements.provenance: geometry, material, source, artifact, model, code, schema, cells, cusps, terminals, losses, and mirrors carry SHA-256 identities
geometry_requirements.identity: canonical JSON includes positions, confidence, full loss covariance, and excluded-null IDs/reasons

publication.rank_deficient: prohibited unless expected structural rank holds and an orthonormal scaled right-nullspace basis passes canonical Jv tolerance
publication.backend: untrusted candidate generator; status and residual claims never authorize publication
publication.false_state: state and evaluation are null when any publication gate fails

physical_claim_status: software formulation and verification contract only
